relevance.rationale: A three-page editorial introducing a special issue marking three decades since a foundational chiral-effective-field-theory paper. It contains no theorem, no derivation and no data -- roughly two pages of historical framing followed by a list of the issue's twenty-five contributions. The subject area does touch the corpus's binding-energy programme, but an editorial has nothing for any block to consume; the citable objects are the papers it points at, not this. Recorded as not-relevant rather than tangential because 'no result this paper can consume' understates it: there is no result here at all.

proposedActions.rationale: Nothing to cite. If the corpus later wants a chiral-EFT anchor for its binding work, the target is the underlying foundational paper or one of the listed contributions, not the editorial.
